articleTitle: The Training Set Automating for a Neural Network Model of an Industrial Robot Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The industrial robot control system solves a large number of tasks that affect the ease of integration and efficiency of the manipulator in the technological process. One of its main tasks is to calculate in real time the trajectory of the manipulator flange movement taking into account the selected type of movement. In particular, this task can be solved using a neural network model. The article describes the solution of the problem of automating the creation of a training set for a neural network model that forms the trajectory of movement of an industrial manipulator. The source of data for the set is a KUKA KR4 R600 manipulator and its digital twin created in the “Rational Production” software. The training set includes many sets of the manipulator joint angle vectors (generalised coordinates) that uniquely define the current position of the robot and its flange in space.

articleTitle: Methods for Assessing the Quality of Educational Processes of a Standard Model of a Digital University of the Sixth Technological Order
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: In the traditional approach to education, the educational process is understood as an organized and purposeful impact on the student (the need to form him into a personality with given qualities). But in modern student-oriented pedagogy in the educational process, it is not the impact that occurs, but the interaction with the student or listener. Considering this point, the formulation of the educational process will sound like an organized interaction between a teacher and a student to achieve educational goals. In the context of a digital university, this process acquires distinctive features due to the use of digital technologies and services.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation: When Business Processes Become a Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article considers analogies between business processes, process architecture and neural networks concepts. The author draws parallels between business processes and neurons, as well as between process architecture and neural networks. It is shown that these analogies allow the application of methods and approaches developed in the field of artificial intelligence to the modelling, analysis and optimisation of business systems. In addition, the relationship between Six Sigma methodology and the tuning and training of artificial neurons is discussed.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies Integration into the Mechanism High-Tech Enterprises Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The formation of a sustainable development strategy for an enterprise is based on fundamental principles. Sustainable development goals are determined by enterprise performance indicators. To achieve the set goals, it is advisable to carry out sustainable development of the enterprise on the basis of a system of balanced indicators in order to increase socio-ecological and economic efficiency. One of the key tasks of digital transformation of high-tech industrial enterprises is the selection of suitable technologies and systems that will be integrated into the business processes of the enterprise.

articleTitle: Forecasting the Resources of Rolling Stock Elements Using Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: In this article, the capabilities of information technology for forecasting vehicle resources directly affect the safety, efficiency and economic reliability of railway communications. The proposed method is based on the analysis of historical data of wheel sets, which were obtained from various sources. This method includes the following stages of information and software processing, which include loading data into databases, checking and primary data processing, machine learning using artificial intelligence to transfer historical data, and a linear regression algorithm.

articleTitle: Balanced Scorecard and Six Sigma Systems in the Context of Digital Transformation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: This article proposes fascinating and innovative methods for visualizing and analyzing Balanced Scorecard (BSC) and Six Sigma outcomes in the context of project management, enhancing project management procedures, and designing digital processes and products. The construction of a multidimensional matrix as a powerful data visualization and key project KPIs trend tracking tool is emphasized. The integration of BSC and Six Sigma allows the complete assessment of project performance and quality, resulting in improved effectiveness and customer satisfaction. In general, these methods are valuable instruments for managing projects and enhancing the quality of digital products during digital transformation.

articleTitle: Formation of an Intellectual Resource of an Enterprise Using Virtual and Augmented Reality Technologies Based on Sociodynamics Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The preparation of the intellectual resource of the enterprise for innovative projects to create high-tech products is carried out on the basis of existing management personnel at the enterprise. The implementation of the formation of a management strategy requires, on the basis of a system of uniform priority criteria, the training of highly professional engineering personnel with inventive abilities. The intellectual resource is a modular complex that includes the following modules: high-tech products, information support and a highly professional personnel reserve. The result of multidisciplinary educational processes is the formation of intelligence and creative thinking within the framework of these areas for the creation of unique high-tech products.

articleTitle: Application of Multiclassification for Detecting Intrusions in IoT and Their Type Recognizing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The goal of the work is to identify the possibility of using machine learning algorithms with a multiclass approach to detect attacks in Internet of Things (IoT) networks, determine their type, improve the security of IoT devices, protect devices and their users from attackers. The experimental results show that the proposed multi-layer gradient boosting classifier model can achieve better prediction of small classes without sacrificing the prediction performance of numerous classes, but requires much more time than other methods. The second algorithm that has good accuracy is the Extra Trees algorithm with affordable detection time. At the same time, the method has good learning efficiency indicators. This means that this algorithm can be deployed and applied with the greatest success.

articleTitle: Methods of Component IT-Security Risk Assessment for IT Critical Infrastructure Entities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: When quantifying the security risks of IT critical infrastructure entity components, the well-known requirements of functional security standards are followed. Unlike many regulatory and industry requirements, functional security standards are based on quantitative risk assessments. This publication shows examples of computing the cumulative security level of IT critical infrastructure entities, subject to the implementation of current standards of risk components quantifying. Examples of “direct” estimation are presented - the cumulative risk level of IT critical infrastructure entities is evaluated by available estimates of components (controllers) and “reverse” one - when the minimum acceptable risk level of all components within a particular IT critical infrastructure entity is evaluated by known customer requirements. The obtained results can be used in the security estimates of IT critical infrastructure entities.

articleTitle: Process Architecture as a Neural Network and Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article considers the possibilities of artificial intelligence (AI) application in digital production management. The authors note that the use of AI technologies opens up many opportunities for increasing efficiency, optimising processes and making more informed decisions in various fields: ‐Demand forecasting and production planning ‐Logistics and supply chain optimisation ‐Predictive maintenance of equipment ‐Automation of routine tasks ‐Analysing big data to uncover hidden patterns AI systems are capable of processing huge amounts of data, identifying complex relationships and offering solutions that humans may not be able to see. This improves flexibility, responsiveness and quality of production management.

articleTitle: Implementation of Contemporary Risk Management Standards for Decision Support System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: When implementing complicated, geographically extended complex projects, it is important to ensure a number of requirements are met at the same time. Compliance with deadlines, quality and financial limits are among the important requirements that need to be met all at once. Definitely, application of advanced IT technologies fulfilling complex risk management is essential for effective problem solving. The publication shows what contemporary standards of risk management can be applied as part of IT solutions used or developed for companies dealing with complex projects. The results obtained can be adopted for common and special projects implemented for the big companies.

articleTitle: Process Architecture as a Neural Network in Digital Manufacturing. Main Characteristics, Elements and Metrics
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article considers the analogy between process architecture in digital production and neural networks. The author details the main characteristics, elements and metrics by which parallels can be drawn between the two concepts. It is shown that process architecture, like neural networks, has the properties of interconnectivity, adaptability and hierarchy. Analogies between the inputs/outputs, transformations, connections and control of processes and the corresponding elements of neural networks are examined. Key metrics such as performance, quality, flexibility and robustness are also compared. The paper then presents analogies between business process modelling and neural modelling, and between process architecture modelling and neural network design.

articleTitle: Digital Model of Temperatures and Stresses in the Diamond Crown During Drilling Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: A digital model of temperatures and stresses in a diamond crown under the action of force and temperature disturbances from the drilling process has been developed. By solving the problems of thermal conductivity and thermoelasticity in the finite element formulation, stress concentration zones in crown structures were identified, requirements for the mechanical and thermophysical properties of materials to ensure stress reduction were determined. It is shown that the stress state of the instrument is largely determined by thermal influences. The model can serve as a basis for digital doubles at the stages of development, production and operation of the crown life cycle.

articleTitle: Problems of Training Engineers for Digital Economics in Regional Universities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article examines the problems of engineering education in universities of the North Caucasus region using the example of the Kabardino-Balkarian Republic. It is noted that the high demand for engineering personnel at industrial enterprises is determined not only by trends towards increasing production volumes, but also by the need to expand its innovative component. The main directions for solving the problem of training engineers for the digital economy are outlined. The most sought-after competencies have been identified that will help an engineer successfully perform job functions in a modern digital enterprise.

articleTitle: Application of Deep Machine Learning Methods to Solve Mathematical Physics Problems in Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: This article discusses the importance of using deep machine learning methods to solve problems of mathematical physics in production. An overview of the main methods of deep machine learning - neural networks, convolutional and recurrent neural networks is provided. Forecasting of the technical condition of equipment, optimization of production processes, analysis of experimental data and modeling of physical processes are considered. Examples of successful application of deep machine learning methods in leading companies are given. An analysis of the advantages and limitations of using deep machine learning methods allows us to assess their effectiveness and possible problems when used in production.

articleTitle: Scientific Publication Clustering on Autonomous Maritime Navigation to Target Scientific Communities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to present an approach to a survey of scientific publications by clustering them, using the example of papers dedicated to autonomous marine navigation. The proposed approach makes it possible to carry out the data mining technology with the following visualization of the results as a non-directed graph, comprising a set of clusters. Each cluster is a research team working on a given topic. The analysis of the data on the research teams makes it possible to imagine the ideas of the scientific groups that contribute to uncovering the problems of autonomous navigation at sea. And information analysis of the most frequent keywords and word combinations will help to define the way autonomous marine navigation is moving. The paper deals with the open source software for visualization and analysis of the linked data Gephi to perform data mining. This type of approach to reviewing scientific publications allows the interaction of the contributions of scientific teams to be visualized and analysed in a clear and open way. It also makes it possible to identify scientific groups that make a significant contribution to the range of research topics being developed. In addition, the information analysis of the most frequently used keywords and word combinations will help to identify tendencies and trends in the development of the scientific field.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence of Digital Production Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article considers the application of artificial intelligence (AI) in digital production management. The authors note that the use of AI technologies opens up many opportunities to improve efficiency, optimise processes and make more informed management decisions. Key applications of AI in this area include demand forecasting and production planning, logistics and supply chain optimisation, predictive maintenance of equipment, automation of routine tasks, and big data analysis to uncover hidden patterns. The use of AI in business process management in digital manufacturing, including production process optimisation, supply chain management, quality control, and decision support, is discussed separately. It is emphasised that a key advantage of AI is its ability to process large amounts of data, identify hidden relationships and offer optimal solutions. The article considers the representation of process architecture in digital manufacturing as analogous to neural networks in artificial intelligence. The author notes that this approach has both advantages and disadvantages.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Multistage Compression of Convolutional Layers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: Algorithms based on neural network models are effective for solving a wide range of problems, including compression of neural network models, which allows efficient use of models with limited resources. Their application allows reducing the total volume of the model and, as a consequence, reducing the computational load. The presented iterative low-rank tensor approximation algorithm outperforms single-stage methods while maintaining the required model accuracy, and its purpose is the compression of any neural network model architecture, which utilizes convolutional and fully connected layers. Testing of the presented algorithm has shown an accuracy advantage of 22-74% compared to the existing ones.

articleTitle: Honeycomb Composite Defect Detection: Comparative Analysis of Thermography Processing Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The report discusses non-destructive testing of polymer composite materials with honeycomb fillers. Three methods of processing thermogram sequences are considered for controlling such materials using active scanning thermography. A comparison of the methods is made based on their accuracy in identifying defects such as “delamination” with various geometric characteristics. The work was carried out using an active thermography setup based on a three-axis CNC portal-type gantry system with a movable portal. Registration of the non-stationary temperature field was performed using a COX CG640 infrared camera. The possibility of identifying defects such as “delamination” with different thicknesses of the filler delamination in the model sample: from 0.1 mm to 0.8 mm under a 0.5 mm thick facesheet is assessed.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation and Business Processes Integration in the Effective Management Decision-Making Mechanism at Transportation Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: Digital transformation is an important aspect of the development of modern enterprises. It involves the integration of business processes with information technology (IT) systems and technologies to improve the efficiency and competitiveness of the enterprise. Digital transformation aims to create a flexible, innovative and adaptive organization that is able to respond quickly to changes in the external environment and meet the needs of customers. The purpose of this study is to determine the relationship and mutual influence of digital transformation of business processes and the mechanism of effective managerial decision-making.

articleTitle: Digitalization of the Processes of Reading Documents Using Software Systems and Assessing the Quality of Building Materials
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The practice of implementing machine-readable documents in software systems for the design, production and quality assessment of building materials is insignificant compared to the modern needs of designers, product manufacturers and builders. This article is devoted to testing the operation of machine-readable standards in the process of manufacturing metal structures and assessing their quality.

articleTitle: Ensuring Interoperability of Digital Product Models
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: Ensuring the quality of digital models is one of the main tasks in the design and manufacture of technical products and structures. The work aimed at solving data processing problems to ensure the intensity of models and digital doubles of products. In the era of digital transformation, a transition to registration in digital models of products of the properties of the materials from which they are manufactured is necessary. The methodology of accounting in digital models of communication products of the properties of materials to ensure the reliability of their production is proposed.

articleTitle: Vulnerabilities of Artificial Intelligence Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article examines artificial intelligence (AI) vulnerabilities in the context of cybersecurity, analyzes their resilience and provides vulnerability statistics. The classification of specific for the AI system vulnerabilities is given, in which 4 types of attacks are identified and described. The experiment was conducted on the simulation of an attack on a neural network using FGSM method in order to compare the efficiency of the neural network before and after the attack.

articleTitle: Robotic Quality Control of Products Made of Polymer Composite
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The report considers the solution to the urgent problem of quality control of products made of composite materials with a honeycomb filler. The proposed method of thermographic control with a linear heat emitter makes it possible to examine large-sized products with a one-dimensional curvature of the surface. The movement of the heat source over the control area is carried out by a robot manipulator, and the registration of an unsteady temperature field is carried out by a thermal imaging camera from COX CG640. The informative parameters of the temperature field have been determined, which make it possible to detect subsurface defects of delamination type with the area above ∼10 mm2 for broken bonds between outer panel up to 0.5 mm thick and honeycomb filler of the material in automatic mode.

articleTitle: Model of Student and Teacher SMART University of the Sixth Technological Order
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The importance of digital competencies for successful development in modern society is not in doubt. The student and teacher are an integral part of the university's digital environment and the presence (absence) of the necessary competencies determines its success, relevance and adaptability to all digital processes. Digital competencies should develop along with critical thinking, the ability to self-learn, and creativity. The presented student and teacher model is an attempt to systematize existing data about students and teachers of a digital university of the sixth technological order.

articleTitle: An Approach to Forecasting Electricity Consumption at Railway Locomotive Depots
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: Energy management of locomotive depots is an urgent task for railway transport. The paper discusses the problem of forecasting data on electricity consumption by locomotive depots. The SARIMA model is used to solve this problem [1]. Autocorrelation function and partial autocorrelation function are used to find model parameters. The accuracy of the predicted calculations was assessed using the MAPE metric. The paper presents the results of computer modeling for energy consumption data of locomotive depots of one of the railways of the Russia. The novelty of the approach lies in the fact that for locomotive depots, energy consumption forecasts were designed without taking into account the specifics of production in locomotive depots. As a result of the work recommendations were proposed to reduce the consumption of electricity by using Metering Data Management System. The obtained technique can be applicable to other consumers of electricity in railway transport.

articleTitle: Development of an Adaptive Protocol for Packet Data Transmission
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The development of telecommunication networks is determined both by global trends and the specific situation in which this industry has been for a long time. When using such networks, it is important to maintain a sufficient level of data transmission quality. Therefore, the purpose of this work is to create a technique that allows making adaptive tuning of protocol parameters at the link layer. This technique should also include a channel testing mechanism. The analysis showed that the current existing codes couldn't cope with a large number of errors, so it is proposed to create a new method of data encapsulation, which provides a lower value of loss. The application of the method proposed in our work for adjusting protocol parameters at the link level showed that the quality of communication is maintained significantly longer, even with a high degree of loss (50<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>), compared to analogues.

articleTitle: Digital Linguodidactic Resource for Teachers Based on Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: In the context of the digital transformation of education, teachers face to the tasks of adaption to modern technological requirements and expansion their own teaching tools by using digital instruments during the lesson. The article describes the experience of creating a digital methodological resource for a foreign language teacher, presents its structure and algorithms of work. The authors describe the technological features of the online lesson constructor. Artificial intelligence technologies are integrated into the resource and allow teachers to automate the performance of a number of pedagogical tasks, thereby saving the time. Such tasks include the generation of a lesson plan, elements of educational content, and automated assessment of academic results. The authors analyze the advantages and limits of using neural network tools in the design and implementation of a foreign language lesson. It is concluded that the created resource allows solving existing problems, because It provides a quick search, collection and generation of digital materials for the purposes of educational activities, as well as the construction of lessons and their fragments.

articleTitle: Balanced Scorecard and Six Sigma Integration in IT Project Management, Digital Processes and Products Design
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The integration of the Balanced Scorecard (BSC) and Six Sigma methodology allows organizations to enhance their efficiency and quality. While the BSC defines key strategic objectives, Six Sigma utilizes statistical tools to identify and eliminate sources of defects that impede the achievement of these objectives. The amalgamation of these approaches yields numerous benefits, including improved planning, enhanced customer value, increased profitability, and heightened competitiveness. To effectively visualize multidimensional data and results of the integration, it is recommended to employ three-dimensional radar charts created using data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Python. These charts provide a visual representation of information, facilitating informed decision-making by individuals responsible for strategic planning and quality management. In a specific example of a mobile application, the BSC can be used to define key goals (brand awareness, number of downloads, user experience quality), while Six Sigma is employed to identify and eliminate defects in the application's design, functionality, and performance.

articleTitle: Management of the Internal Production Environment of the Enterprise Based on the Artificial Intelligence Methods
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: Management is considered within the framework of a process approach. Management involves performing tasks that are interconnected through communication and decision-making. Management of the enterprise is the important and actual problem. To solve this problem, it is proposed to use the new artificial intelligence methods, artificial neural networks and fuzzy logic. The task is to design the artificial intelligence system which can work as the assistant of a man-manager. The objects of the research are the automated control systems. The automated control systems get the control commands from operator and input signals from the external environment and internal production environment. The output signals of the automated control system change the state of the internal production environment. The result of investigation is the quality improvement.

articleTitle: Identifying Risks of Implementing Imposed Security Measures for IT Critical Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: As we know, state-of-the-art entities that are duly classified as IT critical infrastructure entities require a whole complex of technical and other measures to ensure security. Technical measures traditionally include built-in components of automatic control systems, tested for security requirements as part of a single entity. However, the use of extra or “imposed” security measures does not facilitate security of IT critical infrastructure entities. The publication shows examples of computing the total security level of IT critical infrastructure entities with respect to the imposed security measures. The results obtained can be used in the calculation of IT critical infrastructure entity security.

articleTitle: Choosing an IT Strategy for Digital Transformation of Production Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: There are several strategies for the digital transformation of production. The choice of strategy is based on the criterion of product quality improvement. A model based on game theory is proposed. There are two players in the game: The first player is the external environment. The second player is the enterprise management system. Each player chooses and forms his own game strategy. Each player has his own goal and his own criteria for winning the game. The result of the implementation of different strategies is the win. The amount of each player's winnings is estimated in conditional points. It is necessary to choose the strategy that gives the greatest gain. To solve this problem, it is proposed to use game theory, fuzzy logic, and artificial neural networks. The expected result is the increase of the product quality

Author Keywords: internal production environment of the enterprise

articleTitle: Algorithmization of Automation and Service Management Processes of an Industrial Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The ever-growing competition among manufacturing enterprises requires paying closer attention to the quality of products and their competitiveness at the global market. Product quality is directly determined by the efficiency of business processes throughout the product lifecycle. The process of post-production support and product maintenance is part of the product life cycle. Automated customer relationship management systems (CRM systems) are an effective and modern means of monitoring and optimizing post-production support and service processes. The article discusses the problems of automation and management of enterprise services using modern solutions in the field of information technology. The obtained algorithms of service management cover the stages of warranty, post-warranty service, provision of advisory services for the commissioning of products. Based on the data obtained, the analysis of the stages of post-production support that require automation is carried out. Automation of processes is achieved by implementing the obtained algorithms into a CRM system connected to a unified IT infrastructure of the enterprise.

articleTitle: IT-System Strategy and Structure Development Algorithm of Transportation Industry Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: At the current stage of economic development, enterprises of the transport industry to improve the organization of internal and multimodal transportation to a large extent requires the introduction of information technology in the management of production processes. The solution to the issues of improving the efficiency of transport companies relies on the development of IT system strategy as a whole and the design of the information system, taking into account the peculiarities of the company's functioning and its existing organizational and management structure. The subject of research in the article is the strategy and structure of the IT-project. The companies of the transportation industry are considered as the object of research. The theoretical and methodological basis of the study is the systemic, complex, situational, process approaches to problem formulation and search for ways to solve the problem. The research is based on such principles as objectivity, specificity, development, regularity, systematicity. The study used scientific methods - engineering and economic, heuristic, expert, modeling method. The practical significance of the study lies in the justification and definition of the main stages of IT strategy development and design of the information system of the enterprise of the transportation industry.

articleTitle: Quality Control of Information-Measuring Systems Based on Synchrotron Radiation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: Task (goal of the work) Development and improvement of high-precision methods and means of metrological support for quality control of information-measuring systems when solving applied measuring tasks in priority directions of science and technology. Solution method: The method of estimation of accuracy and reliability of results of quality control of information-measuring systems is based on the use of reference sources of synchrotron radiation for plasma diagnostics, analysis of solar activity, location of remote objects, control of bactericidal effect of UV radiation, for determination of threshold values of brightness contrast and for investigation of multilayer structures of micro- and nanoelectro nics. Results: The results and implementation prospects of synchrotron radiation radiometry methods for improving the quality of spectroradiometers, radiometers and photometers in the partnership cooperation of RTU MIRE A with Kurchatov Institute and VNIIOFI are considered. Developed are the requirements for high-precision measuring instruments and standard samples adapted to polar scientific research during the realization of the project on the development and conservation of unique ecological systems of the Arctic. The principles are proposed of building digital models of high-precision measuring instruments for solving quality control problems in planning and optimization of production resources, taking into account modern approaches to quality management, standardization and production organization.

Author Keywords: multilayer structures sources of synchrotron radiation

articleTitle: Review of Lane Change Systems Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The decision of lane change problem is one of the sophisticated and accuracy demanding task in ADAS development process. Lane change task can be characterized as non- linearity with high fraction of uncertainties. This is caused by dynamic changeable traffic environment and thus one of state of the art approach to solve this problem is the use of machine learning technic. In this work lane change systems based on reinforcement learning methods were observed. These lane change systems are provided by specific modification of deep Q-network (DQN), deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG). In the process of consideration descriptions and the comparison of proposed methods are given from position of Average Velocity and Collision Times.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Confidentiality of Enterprise Information Resources by Means of Steganography Methods in Music Notations and Records
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: Ensuring the proper level of information resources confidentiality is actual goal for modern enterprises. However, it is also important to conceal the very fact of the presence of confidential data or the possibility of obtaining access to it. Most modern enterprises use legend methods, but they are not sufficient to solve the problem. The article presents the methodology for using steganography to increase the level of confidentiality of enterprise information resources. According to the methodology, it is proposed to use music notations and records as steganography containers. The results of the research, conducted by the authors, are applicable both in transfer processes, and in storage of valuable and important enterprise information resources.

articleTitle: Digital Technologies and a Process Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: One of the key principles of building modern production is the process approach. The processes determine the possibility and efficiency of obtaining modern materials and products, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, electronic and any other products. On the other hand, process management at the current stage of technology development requires the use of modern digital technologies. Decision-making on process adjustments becomes possible directly during their realization. In some cases, it is possible to use artificial intelligence and use predictive analytics. Another possible use of digital technologies is the management process and the reduction of managerial errors.

articleTitle: Providing a Digital Pipeline for IT Digital Transformation Projects
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: As practice has shown, the implementation of significant IT digital transformation projects requires the efforts of a large team, substantial financial outlays and several years of initiatives undertaking. As we know, the success of such significant IT projects is a crucial factor in survival, even for large integrated companies, and in gaining important competitive advantages. Definitely, the success of such initiatives depends on many factors, and the key one is considered to be the input data quality. This publication shows examples of insufficiently verified “raw” input data identified in the number of IT digital transformation projects and examples of “digital pipeline” implementation to ensure reasonable and quick decisions of top management. The findings can be used for digital transformation projects for the benefit of various companies.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Two Simulation Environments for Robots, Gazebo, and CoppeliaSim in the Context of Their Use for Teaching Students a Course in Robotic Systems Modeling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: This article presents a comparative analysis of two simulation environments for robots and robotic systems - Gazebo and CoppeliaSim. The study evaluates their functionality and effectiveness for teaching students robot and robotic system modeling. The analysis was conducted based on the following criteria: user interface convenience, availability of educational materials, simulation realism, support for various types of robots and sensors, and integration capabilities with other software. As a result, our research allowed us to identify the main advantages and disadvantages of each simulation environment. These findings will help determine the most suitable tool for robotic education, thereby improving the quality of training for professionals in this field.

articleTitle: Spectral Analysis of Signals with Uneven Sampling Using the Example of Preprocessing of Profilograms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: Spectral analysis of experimental signals measured with uneven sampling gives an error that does not allow practical use of the results. An algorithm and a computer program for converting a signal with an uneven measurement pitch into a signal, with a uniform pitch (“pitch equalization”), have been developed. The signals are represented by coordinate series. The algorithm is based on the symbolic Dirac unit impulse function of a real variable and its approximation by a continuously differentiable function. The algorithm was tested on the experimental results of measuring the profilogram of the outer surface of a cylindrical sample processed by turning. The results of spectral analysis of profilograms with a uniform measurement step are given.

articleTitle: Technology of Rotor Systems Modelling of Industrial Machines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: This paper describes the technology of rotor systems modelling as the main elements of industrial machines (machine tools, measuring machines, etc.). The approach is based on the principle of a close combination of computational and experimental methods of investigation of industrial machines (theoretical and experimental modal analysis) and the multimodel principle, which allows for the simultaneous use of several object models. It is assumed that models will be employed in a variety of contexts, including the temporal, modal, and frequency domains, for both theoretical and experimental research methodologies. Illustrative schematics are provided to illustrate the potential combinations of models at different stages of the system life cycle.

articleTitle: The Use of Artificial Intelligence Algorithms in Foreign Languages Teaching
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of the phenomenon of artificial intelligence and neural networks in the framework of foreign language education. The authors analyze the possibilities of these digital resources in foreign languages teaching. The article discusses current issues of the development and implementation of neural networks, describes their technical and technological characteristics for the educational content development. It has been identified and presented both the teaching and evaluating potential of neural networks in the practice of foreign languages teaching. It is presented the algorithm of software implementation in the form of an application. The authors analyze the existing tools of neural networks, the range of their capabilities in organizing feedback to students and the additional conditions that arise in this regard for mastering a foreign language. The article provides an algorithm for developing educational content based on neural networks for the development of all types of foreign language speech activity. They are given some methodological recommendations that describe the advantages and limits of using neural networks in the practice of foreign language education.

articleTitle: Application of Data Quality Management Techniques to the Standards Development Process
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article discusses the application of a monitoring system for the development of standards based on the use of these information systems. The purpose of the study is to create a process monitoring and management system using process mining and process mining techniques based on data analysis. The article also discusses data quality management techniques, the use of which will improve the quality of the monitoring system of the standards development process. Also, the application and implementation of the techniques discussed in the article will contribute to increasing the level of digital maturity of the standards development process and will allow building high-quality models of the standards development process for creating digital twins.

articleTitle: Main Stages of Designing the Digital University of the Sixth Technological Order
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The transformation of universities into a digital format, which is taking place all over the world, is a powerful factor in the formation of a digital society and thereby increasing the efficiency of the digital economy as a whole. To successfully complete the stages of transformation, it is necessary to correctly design a digital university, taking into account the correctly placed emphasis received from the management and educational departments. The creation of a digital university, based only on individual elements of the use of digital products and services, is not capable of ensuring the efficiency of the process, and cannot be called digital transformation. The importance of the design stage is obvious and allows us to take into account the needs of stakeholders and ensure the future competitiveness of the university. The purpose of the development proposed in the article of design stages is the formation of a consistent action plan, taking into account complexity, various directions and the need to form a holistic project, taking into account the interests of educational and administrative departments. To achieve this goal, it is necessary to solve a number of problems aimed not only at the selection of digital services, but also at the ability to use them effectively, taking into account the needs of the main stakeholders, ultimately aimed at achieving the key goals of the university.

articleTitle: The Architecture Designing Algorithm of a Digital High-Tech Enterprise Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference "Quality Management, Transport and Information Security, Information Technologies" (QM&TIS&IT)
abstract: The article discusses the design of an architecture for the sustainable development of a digital high-tech enterprise. Business processes, information flows, technological solutions and information security in the context of digitalization should be aimed at increasing the efficiency and competitiveness of the enterprise. The basis for the functioning of these processes is engineering and reengineering of enterprise architecture. Increasing the production efficiency of a high-tech industrial enterprise is possible not so much through improving its investment policy, but on the basis of a balanced system of performance indicators in order to achieve the unity of public and collective interests.
